Garr Reynolds has an excellent blog about giving great, bullet point free Presentations: http://www.presentationzen.com/

His book, Presentation Zen, comes highly recommended (not a referral link): http://www.amazon.com/Presentation-Zen-Simple-Delivery-Edition/dp/0321811984/

c.st: Why Speakers Earn $30,000 an Hour - Confessions of a Public Speaker
c.x:
I just spent the morning reading this book through O'Reilly's Safari access. It is absolutely brilliant and is up there with Presentation Zen and Slideology as 'must have' books if you're a speaker.

Here's the thing though - despite Scott's best efforts, I don't think this book helps you if you're not already a speaker or somehow interested in speaking. But if you are one or someone like me who enjoys it and is looking to polish 'the craft' this is great. Scott notices a lot of patterns, some of which I do…
